title: Concise & Precise Points
description: Points and sentences must be short and precise — this is what keeps the doc inside the 16-page ceiling (scored end-to-end by the document_length_pages set). Enforced caps: bullets <= 12 words; text blocks <= 2 sentences of <= 18 words each and <= 35 words total; slide heading/subheading <= 4 words each (hard cap, no period); slide title <= 8-word phrase; table cells <= 8 words. Cutting a sub-concept to hit a cap is never the right trade — cut ritual and restatement instead.
criterion: No bullet > 12 words; no sentence > 18 words; heading/subheading <= 4 words; title <= 8 words; no filler words.

rubric.3: One or two lines slightly over.
rubric.1: Multiple long, dense sentences / paragraph-style bullets.

bullets: Sequence numbers keep data in order
